### Preparing Data 

```{r}
# Read in packages 
library(tidyverse)
library(stars)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(tmap)
library(gt)
library(viridisLite)
library(terra)
library(spDataLarge)
library(spData)
library(geodata)
library(kableExtra)
```

# Reading in data
```{r}
# Read in West Coast data 
wc_EEZ <- sf::st_read(here::here('data/wc_regions_clean.shp'))

# Read in depth raster data 
depth <- rast('data/depth.tif')

# Read in yearly annual sst tif files 
rast_08 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif')
rast_09 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif')
rast_10 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif')
rast_11 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif')
rast_12 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif')
```

### Preparing Data

```{r}
# Verify CRS's match 
if (st_crs(wc_EEZ) == st_crs(depth)){
    print('CRS is a match :)')
}else{
    warning('It is not a match:()')
}

# Combine all raster SST rasters 
rasters <- c(rast_08, rast_09, rast_10, rast_11, rast_12)
```

### Process Data 
```{r}
# Calculate average 
avg_sst <- mean(rasters, na.rm=TRUE)

# 

```
